title: Video Content Creator / Créateur de contenu vidéo
description:
LANDR is a fast-growing audio company made up of left-brained creative technologists, right-brained music professionals and everyone in between. Together, we are revolutionizing the process for music makers to help them create, master, distribute and promote their music.
We love music. We love musicians. Our mission is to give music makers the freedom to create and be heard. We bring our love of music to work every day and we are continuously innovating to create experiences that delight and engage our audience of over 6 million music creators.
We're looking for a Video Content Creator to make engaging content for LANDR 's social media. You’ll film and edit, and also be one of the faces and voices of the content! We are looking for someone to bring a pop culture instinct, a working knowledge of music production, and the ability to explain things the way a friend would, not the way a brand would.
This is a 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension, focused on growing our reach with emerging artists and music creators. This position is remote and open to candidates regardless of location.
Before you apply: we ask all candidates to submit a short test video. You'll find the instructions at the bottom of this posting.
What you'll do

• Create and feature on short-form vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram, YT Shorts, etc.

• Create and feature on long-form video walkthroughs

• Pitch video ideas rooted in what's happening in music and pop culture right now, including trends, sounds, releases, and conversations artists are having

• Write or adapt your own scripts and hooks, keeping them tight, jargon-free, and native to each platform

• Collaborate with our social, design, and video teams, on shoot planning and editing notes

• Review performance with the Organic team at LANDR , and use what works to shape the next round of content

• Stay on top of platform trends and formats, and bring new ideas to test

What we're looking for

• On-camera experience as a creator, host, or presenter, with a portfolio or channel we can look at

• A strong, natural presence on camera. You can hold attention in the first three seconds and keep it

• A working knowledge of music production and the modern artist workflow (DAWs, mixing and mastering basics, releasing music independently)

• A sharp ear for pop culture and a real feel for what's resonating with young music creators

• Fluency in TikTok and Instagram Reels culture: hooks, pacing, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling

• The ability to simplify technical ideas without dumbing them down

• Excellent spoken and written English

How to apply: the test

• Along with your application, please submit a short test video.

• Deliverable: one 30-45 second vertical video, in English, in the style of " LANDR Can Do That?", a format built around one underused feature and the one artist problem it solves.

• Pick something from landr.com you find interesting or useful (distribution royalty splits, free mastering, the plugin bundle, whatever) and explain it to the camera the way you'd tell a friend about a hack you just found, not the way a brand would pitch it. Hook in the first three seconds, one feature only, no jargon.

• A phone camera is fine. Send it as a link (unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, whatever's easiest) or as file below.

title: Senior Back End Engineer (Ruby on Rails & GO)
description:
At PrizePicks , we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Overview
At PrizePicks , we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth from real-time contest engines to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a talented and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our Back Office team and help us build the internal platform that powers every operation at PrizePicks .
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer fluent in both Ruby on Rails and Go to join our Back Office team. Back Office is the internal operational platform used by Game Ops, Trading, Member Operations, and Risk teams to configure projections, trade lines, manage members, review risk, and monitor live scoring - all of which directly shapes what millions of members see in the app.
In this role, you will design and build backend services that span our Rails monolith and our growing ecosystem of Rails and Go microservices. You will work across existing as well as new services being carved out as we migrate toward a microservices architecture. You will tackle high-scope, complex technical problems, own features end-to-end, and mentor engineers on your team. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable extending a mature Rails codebase and greenfielding a new Go service, and who is energized by the challenge of a platform in active, deliberate evolution.
What You'll Do

•
Build and own backend services : Design and implement features across both Rails-based services and Go microservices - from API contracts through deployment and monitoring.

•
Support the migration to microservices : Help decompose the Rails monolith into well-scoped, independently deployable services, contributing to architectural decisions about what to extract and how.

•
Power internal tooling APIs : Build and maintain the backend APIs that Back Office operators depend on for real-time decisioning - projection management, risk dashboards, alerting, and member operations.

•

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer at Mercor, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and applied AI research. You’ll own benchmarking pipelines, evaluation systems, and failure analysis workflows that directly inform how we train and improve frontier language models.
Your work will define how we measure tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning. You’ll design and run evals, build rubrics and scorers, and turn failure analysis into actionable improvements for post-training, RLVR, and data pipelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Benchmarking: Design, implement, and maintain benchmarks and metrics for tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning; ensure benchmarks scale with training and stay aligned with product and research goals.

- Data quality and usability: Quantify data usability, quality, and impact on key benchmarks; use evals and failure analysis to guide data generation, augmentation, and curation.

- Cross-team collaboration: Work with AI researchers, applied AI teams, and data producers to align evals with training objectives and to prioritize benchmarks and failure analyses that matter most.

- Ownership in a fast-paced environment: Operate in a high-iteration research setting with strong ownership of benchmarks, evals, and failure-analysis workflows.

- Strong coding skills and hands-on experience with ML models and evaluation code.

- Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and backend systems.

- Ability to reason about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality from evals and failure analyses.

- Excitement to work in person in San Francisco five days a week in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.

NICE TO HAVE

- Industry experience on a post-training or evaluation/benchmarking team (highest priority).

- Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL), especially in evaluation or benchmarking.

- Experience building or running LLM evaluations, benchmarks, or failure-analysis pipelines.

title: Data Engineer, Marketing
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.

What you'll do

- Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

- Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

- Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

- Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

- Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue

You may be a fit if

- You have 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

- You have strong SQL and python skills and are comfortable building both data pipelines and predictive models

- You've run hold-out or incrementality tests and worked with MMM and attribution models in production, and you know the limitations of each

- You understand how ad platforms report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and you don't take platform-reported numbers at face value

- You communicate clearly with channel managers, Finance, and leadership, and you're honest about what the data does and doesn't support

- You're self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end

description:
OVERVIEW
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Freight and Client Services Coordinator. Our client is a specialist international shipping company focused on transporting classic and vintage vehicles from Europe to North America, managing end-to-end logistics across multiple countries and carriers. Solid computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and comfort learning new software platforms

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Prior experience in freight forwarding, shipping, or international logistics, even at a junior or administrative level
Exposure to customs documentation or import/export procedures, whether locally or internationally focused
Experience in a client-facing or customer service role, particularly in a high-volume or deadline driven environment
Familiarity with transport management systems or freight tracking platforms
KEY COMPETENCIES
Strong communication skills
High attention to detail
Strong organizational skills
Ability to work independently
Professionalism and reliability

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. Reporting to Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.
OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.
Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.
This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.
We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.
This is a fully remote role for people based in the United States, working within one hour of US Eastern Time.
Responsibilities

•
Own delivery end to end for OpenMined 's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.

•
Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.

•
Build AI into how we manage projects : use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.

•
Make the whole team better at project management : set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.

•
Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.

•
Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute re

title: Projectvoorbereider Treinbeveiliging
description:
Jouw Ambitie
Wil jij méér verantwoordelijkheid in treinbeveiliging? Als projectvoorbereider zorg jij dat complexe railprojecten strak voorbereid het spoor op gaan. Grotere projecten, meer invloed, volgende stap.
Dit wordt jouw baan
Voor een projectvoorbereider bij Dura Vermeer Railinfra is geen dag hetzelfde. Het accent van jouw takenpakket zal met name liggen in het organiseren en beheersen van de processen die ervoor zorgen dat de monteurs optimaal hun werk kunnen doen. Binnen jouw functie als projectvoorbereider schep je de voorwaarden voor een optimale uitvoering. Zonder jou kunnen de mensen buiten hun werk niet goed uitvoeren.
Projecten waar je bij Dura Vermeer aan kan denken? Bijvoorbeeld het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoor (PHS) project Nijmegen een totale metamorfose van het stationsgebied of de uitbreiding van het emplacement Maasvlakte West van 18 naar 36 sporen. Een grote diversiteit aan projecten. Wij zoeken samen met jou naar een project dat bij je past. Je switcht makkelijk tussen taken, thema’s, bouwvergaderingen en leveranciersgesprekken. Binnen het project ben je de spil tussen ontwerp, uitvoering en commercie. Je ondersteunt zowel op technisch en administratief als op organisatorisch vlak. Verder verzorg je de inkoop en selectie van onderaannemers en stel je de overeenkomsten op. Jij vindt het geen probleem om ongeveer één keer per maand in het weekend op het spoor aanwezig te zijn tijdens een buitendienststelling.
Ook heb jij genoeg technische kennis om alle vragen te kunnen beantwoorden en ben je een daarin een stevige sparringspartner. Je komt te werken in een divers team, waar successen samen gevierd worden. In je werk heb je veel verantwoordelijkheid, maar ook enorm veel vrijheid!
Als verantwoordelijke voor de technische voorbereiding van de treinbeveiliging/seinwezen deelprojecten in een railproject, ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bepalen van benodigdheden, personeel, werkplannen en planningen. Je werkt samen met de uitvoering om werkmethoden af te stemmen en zorgt voor afstemming met onderaannemers. Je bewaakt de technische randvoorwaarden en rapporteert over kwaliteit, veiligheid, arbeidsomstandigheden en milieu. Je zorgt ook voor afstemming tussen verschillende techniekvelden. Jouw doel is om het project binnen de tijd en efficiënt te laten verlopen.
Requirements
Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent - iconisch én dichtbij - en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.
Dit breng jij mee

• Je hebt een minimaal afgeronde mbo opleiding in een technische richting, zoals elektrotechniek;

• Je hebt een aantal jaren werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie als werkvoorbereider of technisch coördinator bij voorkeur binnen de railsector;

• Je beschikt over kennis van arbeids-, milieu- en veiligheidsregelgeving, en over algemene kennis van treinbeveiligingstechniek;

• Je hebt ervaring in het lezen van rail verkeerstechnische ontwerpen (RVTO)

• Je wordt enthousiast van het werken door heel Nederland en je bent bereid om ook in de weekenden, avonden en nachten aanwezig te zijn om je collega’s te helpen waar nodig.;

• Je bent sterk in plannen en orga

title: Associate (Education)
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate at Faculty, you will join a collaborative team scoping, building, and delivering impactful AI projects across education and public services. You will support work streams alongside assessment bodies, educational platforms, and government partners to ensure bespoke AI solutions are safe, evidence-backed, and practical.

We will look to you to nurture trusted client relationships, translate operational needs into clear delivery plans, and partner with technical teams to deploy tools that genuinely improve learning outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to build your career at the forefront of safe, purposeful AI innovation.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Managing individual work streams to support the smooth delivery and deployment of bespoke AI tools across education and public service organisations.

- Working side-by-side with education leaders, publishers, and assessment partners to understand user needs and core learning challenges.

- Translating operational requirements and pedagogical goals into clear, actionable user stories for data science and engineering squads.

- Partnering with AI safety and evaluation specialists to test workflows and ensure solutions uphold rigorous standards of fairness, validity, and evidence.

- Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary project teams to keep delivery on track and maintain exceptional delivery quality.

- Contributing to problem-led proposals, client workshops, and internal thought leadership on the positive impact of technology in learning.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You bring strong analytical thinking and curiosity, with a talent for synthesising complex information and communicating ideas with clarity.

- You have foundational experience working on data, software, or AI-oriented projects, ideally with exposure to public services or educational platforms.

- You demonstrate client-facing experience and take pride in building empathetic, collaborative partnerships that help projects succeed.

- You understand Agile ways of working and appreciate how iterative delivery helps multidisciplinary squads achieve meaningful results.

- You show a thoughtful awareness of why validity, fairness, and safety are critical when applying AI to education and public services.

- You thrive in entrepreneurial settings, bringing initiative, adaptability, and enthusiasm for finding creative solutions

OUR VISION

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10-20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $32M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

 

OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story. Interview with us to hear them!

- 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

- 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

- 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort - we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

- 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it - no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

ABOUT VITALIZE'S ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS TEAM

Our customers operate complex technology environments spanning workforce management, HR, payroll, EHRs, identity, security, and other enterprise systems. As Vitalize takes on larger health systems and expands what our platform can do, the technical complexity of selling, deploying, and supporting our product grows with it.

Enterprise Solutions exists to make that complexity scalable. The function bridges Growth and Post-Sales - ensuring we understand what's technically possible before we sell it, customers are technically ready to go live, and the hardest problems we encounter become repeatable solutions the broader team can own. Done well, Enterprise Solutions helps us activate revenue faster, make deployments more predictable, and scale to increasingly complex customers without scaling technical support linearly.

THE ROLE

You’ll be one of the first two Enterprise Solutions hires at Vitalize, building the function from scratch alongside a peer focused on workforce and payroll systems. Together you’ll define what Enterprise Solutions becomes as our customer base and Post-Sales organization grow.

You’ll own the clinical systems that tell a hospital how much care it needs to staff for: EHRs (Epic, Oracle Health, Meditech, and similar), the interface engines around them, and adjacent acuity and assignment tools. Today that means real-time census, ADT, and acuity data that drives staffing decisions. As Vitalize expands into patient flow and capacity management, your scope grows with it.

Success means EHR integrations that are feasible, secure, and repeatable; deployments that aren’t stalled by interface-team backlogs or security reviews; and a team that becomes increasingly self-sufficient on clinical data because the hardest problems you solve become playbooks, tools, and repeatable capabilities.

title: Enterprise Risk Management Data Analytics Lead
description:

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.
Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

• Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively to executives, business leaders, and non-technical stakeholders.

• Build strong partnerships across business, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and other cross-functional teams to drive reporting maturity and continuous improvement.

• Advance reporting and analytics capabilities by promoting trusted data standards, process optimization, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education

• Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

• Certifications preferred: CISA.

• Other nice to have certifications: AWS Certified Data Analytics, IBM Data Analyst Professional, Google Data Analytics Professional.

Minimum Experience

You’ll be part of the full product design lifecycle, from concept and prototype through flight test and production, and your work will directly shape the flight time, performance, and safety of our uncrewed aircraft.

- Define the CAN/J1939 network architecture, message databases, fault handling and state machines across BMS, PDU, converters, charger and the system management computer.

- Lead supplier engagement: RFI/RFQ, technical evaluation, source selection, and management of suppliers from prototype samples through production.

- Collaborate with mechanical engineering on thermal management and packaging, with electrical engineering on interfaces to powered subsystems, and with software/firmware on controls and diagnostics.

- Produce and maintain design documentation: block diagrams, ICDs, schematics, harness drawings, requirement compliance matrices and design review packages.

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field (power electronics, energy systems)

- At least 5 years of hands-on experience designing and integrating high-voltage (400-800 V) battery and power systems for EVs, commercial/off-highway vehicles, energy storage or defense platforms.

- Direct experience with battery pack and BMS integration, HV distribution (contactors, precharge, fusing, IMD) and HV saf

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.
About the Role:
As a Technical Program Manager , you will be a key player in our pre-sales and customer solutioning efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering to scope technical solutions that align with customer needs and drive Spreedly 's growth. This is a customer-facing, consultative role focused on understanding prospect pain points and designing solutions that connect Spreedly 's platform capabilities to business outcomes.
You will also influence revenue growth, shorten time-to-close, and accelerate value realization for our customers. As Spreedly scales, this role will shape our go-to-market infrastructure through solution templates, demo assets, and mentoring, making it an ideal opportunity for impact and professional growth.
This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.
Responsibilities:

• Lead technical discovery sessions with prospects and customers to identify needs and align use cases to Spreedly 's capabilities

• Deliver compelling demos, architecture diagrams, and documentation that support sales conversations and technical evaluation

• Translate business and technical requirements into actionable solution proposals and implementation plans that support scalability and reuse

• Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, solution artifacts, and objection handling templates

• Work with Product and Engineering teams to provide prospect feedback and ensure solution feasibility

• Partner with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure smooth implementation handoffs

• Serve as a technical expert in RFPs, security reviews, and compliance questionnaires

• Educate internal teams on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and sales enablement materials

Requirements:

• 3+ years in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Account Manager role within a B2B SaaS or fintech environment

• Industry experience with eCommerce, PSPs, payment orchestration, or payment platforms

• Background in payments, card-not-present commerce, fraud, or gateways preferred

• Strong knowledge of APIs, SDKs, and system integration principles (especially REST and webhooks)

• Familiarity with scripting or backend programming (Python, Ruby, or JavaScript a plus)

• Experience collaborating with Sales and Product teams on enterprise deals

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including customer-facing documentation

• Ability to simplify complex technical topics and guide customer decision-making

Additional Skills We Value:

• Comfortable owning discovery and demo stages in an enterprise sales motion

• Experience with implementation or support functions is a plus

We Offer Our US-Based Employees:

• Competitive salary + Equity

• Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid options

• Company-paid Life and Disability insurance

description:

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

As a member of the multinational security management team at IONOS , you will be working for one of Europe's largest hosters in the rapidly growing cloud sector, contributing your knowledge and experience to better protect our products and system landscape. You will be responsible for the design and operation of an integrated management system that includes certified areas from ISO 27001, KRITIS, NIS2, and is constantly being expanded. 

The aim is to encourage and control the implementation and operation of security mechanisms, not only to demonstrate that our products meet the security requirements of the standards, but also to increase the benefits for our customers and the company.

• Regulatory & Certification Alignment: Align our certification frameworks with evolving regulatory requirements, including NIS2 and KRITIS standards.

• Reporting & Executive Interface: Design, compile, and present security metrics and certification status reports to senior management.

• Cross-Disciplinary Risk & Vendor Support: Support risk management, third-party risk assessments (TPRM), security awareness, and incident management disciplines across product lines.

Qualifications

• Background: Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience in cloud/SaaS hosting environments.

• Communication Skills: Fluent in German and English with strong analytical and executive reporting capabilities.

title: Gestionnaire de l'ingénierie, Grand livre auxiliaire// Engineering Manager, Subledger
description:
À propos du poste

À titre de gestionnaire de l'ingénierie pour l'équipe du grand livre auxiliaire, vous serez responsable du système de référence pour chaque transaction financière chez Hopper, assurant l'exactitude des rapports et le rapprochement de tous les mouvements de fonds dans notre écosystème.

Chaque équipe qui traite des transactions, tant pour la réservation que pour l'après-réservation, dépend du grand livre auxiliaire; vous façonnerez donc l'architecture de la plateforme financière d'Hopper aux côtés des équipes Finances, Comptabilité, Paiements et des équipes d'ingénierie produit qui s'y appuient. Vous serez la personne responsable principale sur le plan technique d'un système où l'exactitude et la traçabilité complète comptent plus que tout, conciliant la rigueur comptable et le jugement technique nécessaire à son évolution.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

- Assumer la responsabilité et la gestion de la plateforme de grand livre auxiliaire avec une approche axée sur les résultats, en agissant comme point de contact principal pour les sujets techniques, comptables et opérationnels liés à l'enregistrement et au rapprochement des transactions

- Diriger, faire grandir et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieur(e)s, en définissant l'orientation technique et en prônant l'exactitude dans un système où chaque écriture doit balancer

- Piloter l'architecture du grand livre auxiliaire, en faisant évoluer la conception actuelle vers la simplicité et l'évolutivité grâce à des abstractions solides et à l'automatisation

- Veiller à ce que tous les mouvements de fonds, tant à la réservation qu'après la réservation, soient comptabilisés avec exactitude, avec une traçabilité complète de l'événement source jusqu'au rapport financier

- Établir des relations solides de haut niveau avec les équipes Finances et Comptabilité, en traduisant les exigences comptables en conception de système et en signalant tôt les contraintes techniques

- Collaborer avec les équipes Paiements, Réservations, Après-réservation et Données qui s'intègrent au grand livre auxiliaire, en vous alignant sur les contrats, les modèles de données et les parcours de migration

- Repérer et saisir les occasions de réduire l'effort de rapprochement manuel, de combler les lacunes de production de rapports et d'éliminer des catégories entières d'écarts à la source

- Suivre des indicateurs clés comme l'exactitude des rapprochements, le taux de transactions non appariées, les délais du cycle de clôture et la fiabilité du système, et diriger des revues récurrentes avec les Finances et la direction de l'ingénierie

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Plus de 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont plus de 2 ans en gestion d'ingénieur(e)s, une expérience en fintech, en paiements ou en systèmes financiers étant un atout

- De l'expérience dans la conception et l'exploitation de systèmes transactionnels à haut volume où l'exactitude, l'idempotence et l'auditabilité sont essentielles

- Une connaissance pratique des fondements de la comptabilité, dont la comptabilité en partie double, les grands livres et grands livres auxiliaires, le rapprochement et le processus de clôture financière, ainsi que la capacité de les appliquer à la conception de systèmes

- Une approche systémique de l'architecture, privilégiant des invariants clairs, des abstractions propres et l'automatisation plutôt que les correctifs ponctuels, ainsi que de l'expérience dans la conduite de refontes ou de migrations d'envergure de systèmes financiers en production

- Une communication claire tant avec les comptables qu'avec les ingénieur(e)s, y compris la capacité d'expliquer les compromis techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques

- Un sens de l'organisation et une autonomie marqués dans un environnement en forte croissance

- Être établi(e) dans le fuseau horaire de l'Est ou du Centre, avec un chevauchement quotidien avec les équipes Finances, Comptabilité et ingénierie avec lesquelles vous

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

- Experimentation & Validation: You will collaborate closely with our data scientists to test your fit-for-purpose solutions against our multi-objective optimization problem. We need someone who can rigorously evaluate models through offline experiments and A/B tests before they hit our 100,000+ predictions-per-second production environment.

- Plus: ML Infrastructure Exposure: Any prior exposure to the systems that run our real-time scale-AWS, workflow orchestration (Airflow), containerization (Docker), or basic model deployment workflows-will accelerate your impact.

description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

About the Role

9 Mothers builds hardware in Austin, TX, and this role is the single point of contact for everything that comes into or leaves our building. You own receiving end to end: every package, every packing list, every handoff to the person waiting on it. No prior experience is required. What matters most is that you are reliable and detail-oriented, because a shipment that is misplaced or logged wrong stalls the people who need it.

 

What You'll Do

- Receive every delivery to the building and check it against its packing list

- Log each shipment in our receiving system and keep packing lists filed and traceable

- Organize incoming packages so anything can be found quickly

- Notify recipients when their items arrive and hand them off

- For outbound shipments, package and label the item, drive it to the carrier, and confirm it has gone out

- Keep the receiving area clean and orderly

What We're Looking For

- Reliable: you are here every day, on time, and no delivery goes uncaught

- Detail-oriented: you check quantities and part numbers against the packing list and don't let a discrepancy slide

- Organized, with basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, or an inventory/receiving system)

- Valid driver's license and a clean driving record

- Able to lift and move packages up to 50 lb

- Prior receiving, shipping, warehouse, or inventory experience is a plus but not required

Hours & Location

- Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., onsite in Austin, TX

- The hours are fixed so someone is always on hand for every delivery window

 

Benefits

- Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

- Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

- Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

- The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

- 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

- Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

- Zero Red Tape: You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

- Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

- Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

1. Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call)

2. Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams)

3. Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in-person)

PREFERRED

GDIT is seeking a Sr. Principal RF/Spectrum Systems Engineer to support Counter Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CUAS) engineering for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). In this high-impact role, you will lead the research, testing, evaluation, and spectrum analysis of cutting-edge UAS detection and mitigation technologies in active airport environments.
This position uniquely bridges hands-on RF engineering, advanced systems analysis, and national policy development-directly influencing future FAA Advisory Circulars and aviation safety standards.
Key Responsibilities
RF & Radar Engineering

• Lead radar testing across L, S, C, X, Ku, and Ka frequency bands using FMCW, pulse Doppler, and other waveforms (including Phased Array antenna technologies).

• Lead testing of mitigation devices operating in other frequency bands (VHF/UHF/Microwave).

• Conduct precise RF measurements (power, gain, EIRP, spectrum occupancy) and evaluate electromagnetic compatibility (EM/EMC) for spectral compliance.

• Perform near-field and far-field antenna range measurements in controlled or operational environments.

CUAS Research, Testing & Evaluation (RD/T&E)

• Conduct rigorous spectrum interference testing at active airports prior to CUAS deployment.

• Develop, execute, and oversee detailed test plans, test cards, and structured evaluation frameworks.

• Manage vendor systems during deployment, troubleshooting, data collection, and teardown.

• Establish selection criteria for UAS platforms used in evaluations, alongside performance metrics and pass/fail criteria.

• Document all RD/T&E activities to contribute to FAA guidance on the selection, procurement, deployment, and management of CUAS systems as well as RF-specific measurement equipment.

Systems Engineering & Strategic Policy

• Conduct thorough RF hazard analyses and safety assessments prior to open-air testing.

• Translate complex RD/T&E data into performance specification frameworks using modeling, simulation, and analysis tools to shape FAA Advisory Circulars.

• Utilize technical data tools to model and analyze spectrum environments and system capabilities.

• Create multi-airport CUAS operational recommendations and best practices aligned with FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) principles.

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electrical, Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical (preferred) or other technical discipline. Non-U.S. degrees must be ABET accredited.

• 10+ years of progressive engineering experience in RF, radar, or spectrum management.

• Proven experience using spectrum analyzers and other equipment to test, evaluate and characterize complex RF devices and environments for FCC/NTIA compliance.

• Demonstrated success in conducting open-air RF/spectrum data collection.

• Ability to evaluate the functional capabilities of complex technologies with minimal supervision.

• Highly collaborative with strong technical writing and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences with teams including other disciplines.

• Ability to independently plan and deliver projects with high-quality, on-time results.

• Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Physical ability to lift up to 25 lbs. during field deployments.

• Ability to obtain an FAA Suitability clearance and maintain a valid U.S. passport.

Preferred:

• Direct experience developing or executing structured test plans for aviation or defense technologies.

• Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python, JMP, or advanced Excel).

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees- our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Recruiter to help build an exceptional team at Tremendous. In this role, you'll own the hiring process end-to-end and partner directly with leadership on talent strategy.

We're committed to getting the right people, not just filling seats. You'll need sharp instincts for what makes people successful here and the judgment to consistently identify top talent.

What you'll do

- Own full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles across all teams

- Use your understanding of the talent landscape to source high-caliber candidates

- Conduct initial screens and coordinate interview processes

- Partner with leaders to refine requirements and calibrate on ideal candidate profiles

- Make strategic recommendations on talent acquisition

- Understand funnel dynamics and manage sourcing volume to keep pipelines healthy

What you'll bring

- 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, within 5+ years of total work experience

- Startup experience strongly preferred

- Knowledge of the tech talent market and where strong candidates come from

- Experience maintaining quality while moving quickly in demanding environments

- Strong written communication skills (essential for our high-documentation culture)

- An eye for what makes candidates successful beyond paper qualifications

- Proficiency with recruiting software and tools (Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, etc.)

- Comfort leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies

What's cool about the role

- You’ll help build a world-class team as we expand globally

- Direct partnership with leadership on strategic hires

- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $120,000 to $160,000.

- Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

title: Director of Outreach, Political Campaigns
description:
* Fraud and phishing warning *
Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you

Join the WeVote Movement
WeVote has an open volunteer position for a Director of Outreach, for 3-5 hours or more per week. You are an experienced professional with a passion for helping America navigate our current political environment. This is an opportunity to work remotely with our active team to help us get ready for multiple upcoming elections. Our ideal volunteer is passionate about politics and excited to use technology to educate voters and increase voter turnout. You’ll also gain valuable technical skills, have opportunities for leadership development, and expand your personal and professional network.
About Us
WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 120 active passionate, part-time volunteers (starting with the founders) who build mobile technologies that will touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We believe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a positive voting experience that helps people decide how to vote. More information at or @ WeVote on X.
What You'll Do

• Design and lead national outreach campaigns to engage political candidates, civic organizations, influencers, and public figures across diverse geographies and communities.

• Prioritize outreach efforts based on strategic factors such as electoral milestones, geography, candidate demographics, and underrepresented voter populations.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive outreach calendar by mapping electoral milestones-including registration deadlines, primary and general elections, early voting periods, and runoff dates-to guide campaign timelines, resource planning, and team coordination.

• Coordinate cross-functional campaigns in collaboration with the Marketing, Analytics, Product, and Fundraising teams to ensure consistent, timely, and culturally appropriate messaging across all channels.

• Guide and support team members executing outreach campaigns across regions and target segments, ensuring alignment with milestones and OKRs.

• Build and sustain strategic relationships across the civic and political ecosystem to elevate WeVote ’s visibility, strengthen partnerships, and drive platform adoption.

• Oversee data integrity in all outreach and engagement pipelines, ensuring accurate and timely updates in CRM tools in collaboration with the Analytics team.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of outreach strategy and infrastructure by surfacing insights from field activities, team feedback, and analytics dashboards.

Who you are: Must haves.

• You want to work with an established and successful team. You are committed to strengthening American Democracy.

• You are striving for personal excellence, and want to do meaningful work that will make a difference.

• 3-5 hours per week during our core team hours M-F 8 a.m. - 6 p.m.

• A willingness to work with and support other volunteers.

• Prior experience in campaign strategy, civic engagement, or voter outreach.

• Strong leadership and collaboration skills.

• Comfortable with project planning tools and CRM systems.

• Available at least 1 hour weekly during U.S. business hours.

• Based in the U.S., with some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time.

Submit your resume (at and include a brief note/cover letter to why you are interested in WeVote and helping our mission.
